text: Every building, platform and process area shall have at least two independent escape routes leading in opposite directions where the occupancy allows, with a maximum travel distance to a place of safety of 45 m (30 m within the turbine halls, gas station and other classified areas) and a maximum dead end of 15 m; the escape routes shall have a minimum clear width of 0.9 m (1.2 m for main escape routes and stairs from the control and administration buildings) and a minimum clear height of 2.1 m and shall be kept free of equipment and laydown.
